$description: Button V2 Component Contract. Registry owns axes, legal combinations and Slot properties; this file owns structure, runtime semantics and composition rules.

pointerInteraction.meaning: default, hover and pressed express pointer interaction visuals

availability.meaning: disabled and loading lock activation; loading additionally changes content

intent.meaning: primary, secondary, operation, danger and dark are the five published Button intents; dark uses the dark-surface treatment while remaining an explicit Figma/runtime intent

appearance.meaning: filled, outlined, dashed, filled-inner-shadow, text and link express surface treatment

compositionRules: Intent and Appearance are independent axes and may combine when Registry declares the combination legal.
Default is the initial interaction state and is not an Intent.
Size is shared by the component family; Interaction Size is derived from the shared size contract and is not a new visual axis.
Icon-only has an independent square structure but reuses the Button Size axis.
Loading is a state-owned content replacement and does not add a second loading content axis.
Disabled locks interaction and does not clear or replace the declared semantic content unless loading is active.
Focus Ring is a separate Slot and is resolved by keyboard interaction policy.
Motion hooks are runtime execution points; the Recipe stores only approved motion references.

recipeOwns: container, label, icon, border, focus-ring, spinner and content visual references
shared size, padding and spacing bindings
sparse Intent, Appearance and State visual overrides
contractDoesNotOwn: resolved color, dimension or typography values
